dct_title_s: Official map of San Mateo County, California, 1927
dct_alternative_sm: Official map of San Mateo County California : Showing Pulgas Mosquito abatement district and three cities M.A.D
dct_description_sm: compiled from official records & surveys by Geo. A. Kneese, County Surveyor.
Includes acreage (including coastal territory), names of individuals/companies.
Shows streets (with address numbers), waterways, railroads, boundaries, etc.

Base map, 1927, has annotations in color showing "Pulgas Mosquito Abatement District and Three Cities Mosquito Abatement District", 1934. Library has 145 x 102 cm. map and smaller partial map (87 x 70 cm.) with handwritten annotations, legend, and color shading showing marsh areas by mosquito occurence, including occurrence of A. Dorsalis and A. Squamiger.
